full.description: This image is a diagram showing the cut section of an organ, likely representing a nodular or multinodular condition of the thyroid gland. The illustration depicts multiple reddish-brown parenchyma-like nodules surrounded by pale fibrous or yellowish stromal tissue, characteristic of nodular hyperplasia. The layout exhibits characteristic lobular structures separated by incomplete septa within an enlarged gland.

blind.description: This is a gross pathology specimen image of a thyroid gland. The cut section shows the thyroid enlarged diffusely with lobules of translucent gelatinous light brown parenchyma and areas of haemorrhage. These macroscopic features are suggestive of nodular goiter or a thyroid neoplasm.

random.description: This is a diagram illustrating the histological structure of the thyroid gland. The image shows multiple thyroid follicles of varying sizes filled with colloid and lined by follicular cells. The overall arrangement depicts normal or hyperplastic thyroid tissue architecture. This schematic representation is commonly used to study the microscopic anatomy of the thyroid gland.
